commercialRules.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

commercialRules.createDialogDescription: Name and type are required — its conditions are defined in a version.
commercialRules.versionsDescription: Conditions, precedence and effective dates, by version.
commercialRules.addVersionDescription: A draft version — approve it separately once it's tested and ready.
commercialRules.editVersionDescription: Only a draft version can be edited — an approved version is immutable.
commercialRules.precedenceHint: Resolves which rule applies when more than one could match.
commercialRules.testDialogDescription: Run this version against sample cases before approving it (RULE-02).

evidenceOutcomes.title: Evidence & Outcomes
evidenceOutcomes.description: Claimed results awaiting verification, and the contributions and evidence that back them.
evidenceOutcomes.workspaceDescription: Claimed result, linked contributions, evidence and verification decision.
evidenceOutcomes.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
evidenceOutcomes.emptyDescription: Create an outcome under a partnership to claim and verify a result.
evidenceOutcomes.createDialogDescription: Partnership, type and claimed result are required — a value needs its unit, and vice versa.
evidenceOutcomes.initiativeHint: Optional — scopes the outcome to one initiative under this partnership.
evidenceOutcomes.contributionsDescription: Observed partner input feeding this outcome's claim.
evidenceOutcomes.addContributionDescription: Type, actor, date and narrative are required.
evidenceOutcomes.actorHint: Defaults to you if left blank.
evidenceOutcomes.evidenceDescription: Provenance-linked support for this outcome's claim — verification requires at least one record.
evidenceOutcomes.addEvidenceDescription: Source and observed date are required — attach a file now or upload it afterward.
evidenceOutcomes.sourceHint: A URL or a short description of where this evidence comes from.
evidenceOutcomes.fileHint: Optional — PDF, image, Office document, CSV or text file, up to 25 MB.
evidenceOutcomes.submitDialogDescription: Choose another active owner, admin or reviewer to verify this outcome independently.
evidenceOutcomes.verifyDialogDescription: Verifying preserves the linked evidence as immutable — it cannot be altered afterward.
evidenceOutcomes.noEvidenceWarning: This outcome has no linked evidence yet — it cannot be verified.
evidenceOutcomes.rejectDialogDescription: A reason is required and is recorded with the rejection.
evidenceOutcomes.requestMoreEvidenceDialogDescription: Sends this outcome back to the manager — it can be resubmitted once more evidence is attached.

forbidden.title: Access required
forbidden.description: Ask an owner, admin, executive, manager or reviewer of this organization if you need access to evidence and outcomes.

home.pageTitle: Reven · The Partner Revenue Operating System
home.positioning: The operating system for revenue shared between companies.
home.heroDescription: Manage partners, assign joint work, and verify results in one place.

story.label: One partnership. From plan to proof.
story.title: Shared plans need shared context.
story.description: Keep each agreement connected to its initiatives, decisions, and supporting evidence.

why.title: Less chasing. More progress.
why.description: When plans live in inboxes and spreadsheets, commitments are easy to miss. Reven connects the agreement, the work, and the result.

clarity.label: Clarity
clarity.title: Know where each partnership stands.
clarity.description: See objectives, owners, health, and the next review together. Find what needs attention without collecting updates.

accountability.label: Accountability
accountability.title: Make the next step clear.
accountability.description: Give every action an owner and due date. Track milestones and surface blockers before the next review.

confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.title: Show what was delivered.
confidence.description: Attach evidence to claimed results. An assigned, independent verifier accepts the outcome or asks for more detail.

platform.title: One workspace. From plan to proof.
platform.description: Explore four connected parts of Reven. Each keeps the next step tied to the same partnership.
platform.sceneCaption: Illustration / Four connected parts of a partnership

portfolio.label: Partnerships
portfolio.title: See the relationship in one place.
portfolio.description: Track the partner, objective, owner, health, and next review. Open the full history when you need context.

execution.label: Joint work
execution.title: Turn a plan into assigned work.
execution.description: Set milestones, assign actions, and track blockers. Everyone responsible can see what happens next.

governance.label: Agreements
governance.title: Work from the approved agreement.
governance.description: Keep agreement versions and commercial rules with the partnership. See what was approved and when it changed.

outcomes.label: Evidence & results
outcomes.title: Back every result with evidence.
outcomes.description: Record contributions and supporting files or links. Send the outcome to an assigned verifier for an independent review.

system.title: A clear path from agreement to result.
system.description: Agree on the goal. Assign the work. Review progress. Verify the outcome. Each step keeps the context of the last.

align.title: Align
align.description: Set the objective, agree on commitments, and name the people responsible.

execute.title: Execute
execute.description: Assign actions and milestones. Keep blockers visible as the work moves.

review.title: Review
review.description: Review progress, record decisions, and assign the next actions.

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: Attach evidence and ask an independent verifier to review the result.

system.note: Your team makes the decisions. Reven keeps the record.

teams.title: Built for the people doing the work.
teams.description: Partnership managers, executives, and reviewers work from the same records, with access shaped by their roles.

alliances.label: Partnership teams
alliances.title: Know what to do next.
alliances.description: See the next action, review date, and open blocker for each relationship. Spend less time chasing updates.

leadership.label: Executives
leadership.title: See where attention is needed.
leadership.description: Find partnerships at risk and decisions waiting for approval. Focus the next conversation on what matters.

reviewers.label: Reviewers & verifiers
reviewers.title: Decide with the evidence in view.
reviewers.description: Review agreement versions and assigned outcomes. Keep the supporting evidence and decision history close.

home.tagline: Turning partnerships from a cost center into a profit center.
home.footerNote: Clear ownership. Connected work. Verified outcomes.
home.entryNote: Start with your organization. Invite your team when you’re ready.
home.pilotNote: Explore a shared demo workspace. No account needed.
